# Current native source review

These findings concern the pinned native option maps and current original4K
Overworld graphs. Source applicability is separate from actual execution, image
quality and performance. Pending lifetime evidence is not a zero speedup.

The [frontend comparison](frontend-parity.json) verifies all24 captured attached
terrain stages (SOLID/CUTOUT/translucent vertex/fragment for four packs) against
Asahi's original baselines, and exact equality of the full option maps. Fullscreen
program objects are linked, but their detached attached-stage text is unavailable
in this exporter; they are not included in that parity claim. Parsed ProgramSource
exports and actual bound programs/targets remain separate evidence. GPU binaries,
physical image lifetimes and performance are not transferred from Asahi.

MakeUp G02 has two native mip declarations. composite.vsh reads colortex1 at
log2(min(viewWidth,viewHeight))-1 for exposure, which is positive at3840×2160.
composite1.fsh passes colortex0 to mipmap_bloom, whose samples use positive softLod.
Both vertex and fragment consumers matter; inspecting only composite.fsh's LOD0
read would incorrectly call the first chain dead. Current native options retain
exposure/bloom. No omission is justified by the present inventory.

MakeUp G09 has no native POM traversal/height-map consumer in this profile. The
actual terrain sampler interfaces and source remain the original base-color,
lighting/shadow interfaces. A POM-cache request cannot demonstrate work savings
where no native POM query executes. Other targets' separately pinned PBR profiles
remain real opportunities and are included in the comparison definitions.

C01's native MakeUp SOLID stages match its existing complete source requirements.
The other three SOLID vertex stages differ: BSL calls WavingBlocks before projection;
both Complementary stages call DoWave and include an additional material depth
adjustment. This is not a missing NVIDIA capability. Their geometry needs its own
conservative bounds/material and raster proof before reusing the MakeUp query
permission. A simple host-list expansion would be incorrect.

BSL G01 also needs a complete bank/alpha/history certificate. Native FXAA=true
makes composite6 real AA work; deleting that stage as a pure copy would violate
the native AA constraint. MOTION_BLUR=false makes composite2 a potential copy
branch, but its physical bank/alpha/history equivalence is not certified. Native
composite3/5/7 also update temporal data. This is not a measured zero result.

BSL's native composite4 bloom kernel uses a6×6 offset grid; both Complementary
kernels use7×7 grids. Distinct offsets have nonzero pixel spacing at4K. The MakeUp
G10 exact-coordinate reuse proof does not establish duplicate queries in these
kernels. Edge clamping, cross-tile implicit LOD/derivatives and approximate paired
filtering require separate proofs; no unmeasured gain or generic impossibility is
claimed. The exact MakeUp kernel and its native-equivalent control remain scheduled.

BSL's VolumeLightReuse flag has no operative native consumer in the current route.
Its historical primary-cloud density bound instead pins clear-weather Balanced
and an older target integration. It is not silently substituted for the present
native/Performance lighting-reuse test. Likewise, G04's MakeUp contribution guard
has no already qualified cross-pack equivalent for the other three outputs.

Complementary's identity-pass prototype remains a real source opportunity, with
matching WORLD_BLUR=0/MOTION_BLUR_EFFECT=-1. Its own launch certificate additionally
requires complete physical bank/history/clear and lifecycle/image evidence.
Existing original/next-frame native inventories will be examined before any
omission; the historical held status is not an inherited RTX5080 performance result.
N02/N03 similarly need complete read/write/history and custom-texture ownership.
The overlapping MakeUp copy route gets no additional independent credit.

C02 now has a finite source/target extension for the two separate Complementary
bloom outputs. See [port scope and validation](C02_PORT.md). MakeUp's multiple/full
scene outputs require a different isolated producer; the BSL pass predicate cannot
be broadened by name alone. Actual NV activation/restoration and two-process timing now pass for all three
executable bloom targets. Quality remains under investigation through fresh bounded
motion captures; these are vendor-specific prototypes, not shared v1 qualification.

The compact [22 source dispositions](source-review-findings.json) bind each reviewed
cell to original archive/options and selected source-member hashes. Held lifetime,
geometry and general-route rows are not measured zero, unsupported hardware or
production impossibility. Current scope screens existing mechanisms and repairs
viable general contracts; it does not authorize four unrelated new pack-specific
algorithms to fill timing bars. These source dispositions do not close pending
regression, quality or runtime audit work.

# Native bloom VRS coverage

BSL now passes native RTX5080 functional activation/restoration in both real
GL4.5 and4.6. Both Complementary targets also pass these functional checks. Performance and quality
validation remain unmeasured; context creation alone is not work proof.

The original BSL contract remains intact. Both Complementary originals also have
a separate composite4 bloom-only output, target3 rather than BSL target1. The
current native4K graph exports show the relevant targets at3840×2160 (BSL RGB8,
Complementary RGBA8). MakeUp composite has outputs0/1/6, while composite1 writes
full scene color after adding bloom. The existing single-output bloom scope cannot
coarsen those MakeUp passes without changing additional work.

The finite extension binds each original ZIP to its complete native384/398 map;
a different archive/profile, PBR map, option edit, missing field or foreign key
refuses admission. Source replay still uses the actual pinned Iris inputs and
must match the consumed ProgramSource and its sole declared output. Actual
transformed shader objects, successful link, renderer/pipeline/context/resources,
selected pack/options and physical FBO attachment are required. The original
shader archive and AA/options are unchanged. No generalized family-name bypass
or shader-name-only permission was added.

The runtime now selects the output certified during compilation, instead of
assuming target1 for every family. It also refuses coverage/sample-mask states
and per-primitive shading-rate selection that would undermine the viewport0
contract. Existing unsupported-context, failure, resize, exact-state restoration
and foreign-context/resource custody checks remain. Source fragments with sample
mask or other excluded side effects are refused. This remains a2×2 bloom quality
tradeoff, not image equivalence or default enablement.

The maintained runner admits both balanced orders for C02 and explicitly disables
the VRS request before its final native/MasterOff return. Per-window C02 controls
remain MasterOn with empty public requests and VRS Off. Their identity must not be
misreported as the ordinary public MasterOff controls. A separate functional
quality-motion check is now allowed for this exact route; other private protocols
remain excluded. Recording is never timing evidence.

Local validation:98 benchmark Python tests pass (2 Asahi platform skips);
14 relevant Java tests pass, including authentic original/profile cross-binding,
all required capability/function refusals with zero NV calls, failed-body/setup/
restoration, resize, prior foreign enable/image/palette preservation and context
custody. Development compilation passes. The original-baseline queue is now terminal/restored/released. Its5034 build
bindings were verified and5269 files preserved before native source replacement. Live checks will use both
real4.5 and4.6 requests; actual returned versions and capabilities govern admission.

The [NV extension specification](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/extensions/NV/NV_shading_rate_image.txt)
requires desktop GL4.5 and the mixed-samples extension, defines indexed viewport
enables/palettes and a2×2 rate, and describes sample-state adjustments. These
requirements were checked against the existing backend rather than inferred from
the GPU model. Native driver behavior still needs live validation.


BSL native functional evidence: bsl-c02-gl46-check-r1 and
bsl-c02-gl45-check-r1 both complete VALID with full configuration/profile
restoration, release and zero clients. The NV extension/function requirements
are available. Each candidate owns one certified bloom program and advances
actual activated/restored scopes together; native controls advance neither.
The counters bracket functional work, not isolated timed-window invocation counts.
- 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.42: candidate activated scopes 4366→6975, restored=6975, backend failed=False.
- 4.5.0 NVIDIA 617.42: candidate activated scopes 4500→7101, restored=7101, backend failed=False.

No performance, image-equivalence or quarter-fragment-invocation conclusion follows
from these short functional captures. Per-window controls retain MasterOn/VRSOff.


Both Complementary targets now also complete VALID/restored/reset/released in
real4.5 and4.6: reimagined-c02-gl46-check-r1/gl45 and
unbound-c02-gl46-check-r1/gl45. Exact native profiles/sole output3 are consumed,
required NV capabilities are present, qualified candidate scopes advance and
restore, and native controls advance neither. All six BSL/Complementary checks
remain functional evidence only; scored balanced comparisons and quality are
pending.

records.text:
# Retained RTX5080 evidence

Raw files are deliberately outside Git. Compact measurements, source identities,
plans, scripts, findings and verification receipts are tracked. Native Windows
reports remain under `C:\ShaderLODBench\ShaderLOD\dev\experiments\rtx5080-four-target-audit-20261106`;
the canonical off-host artifact root is this directory on Asahi.

The [terminal audit](terminal-audit-v7.json) verifies all217 operations released,
restored and reset, both managed profiles equal their canonical sources, and zero
Minecraft clients. The final owned scheduled task was removed after checking its
exact helper/request identity, Ready state and successful exit. No other project's
data, NVIDIA cache, personal profile or shared configuration was cleaned.

The full original shader archives/options and managed/canonical client inputs are
retained. Timing results are mirrored in individual report directories, including
raw per-frame vectors, guards, before/after state, operations and build bindings.
The [compact timing summary](timing-summary-v4.json) and CSV/HTML/PNG/SVG can be
regenerated with `analyze.py` and `render-report.py` using the existing chart-env.

Large terminal duplicates were preserved before native retirement:

| Evidence | Retained off-host artifact / receipt |
|---|---|
| First178 world-restore copies | `terminal-world-copies-v1-content.zip`; [migration](terminal-world-copies-v1-migration.json). This replaces the old TAR location while retaining all18512 file paths/bytes with62 unique objects. |
| Terminal screenshots and before/after/restoration world copies | `terminal-heavy-v2.tar.gz`; [receipt](terminal-heavy-v2-verification.json). |
| Terminal native graph exports | `terminal-graphs-v3.zip`; [receipt](terminal-graphs-v3-verification.json). |
| Six later restoration copies | `terminal-world-copies-v4.zip`; [receipt](terminal-world-copies-v4-verification.json). |
| Terminal raw windows and control receipts | `terminal-timing-raw-v7.zip`; [receipt](terminal-timing-raw-v7-verification.json). Individual extracted timing mirrors also remain. |
| Later terminal screenshots/world copies | `terminal-heavy-v8.zip`, `terminal-heavy-v9.zip`; their tracked verification receipts. |
| Nine historical source/class freezes | `frozen/*.zip`; [native duplicate retirement](native-freeze-retirement.json). Native freeze ZIPs were removed only after rehashing both copies; all nine remain off-host. Never reuse an old freeze tag/receipt. |
| Redundant installed-tool/bootstrap download archives | `setup-archives/jdk21.zip`, `setup-archives/runtime-inputs.tar.gz`; [receipt](native-setup-archives-preservation.json). Installed JDK, canonical profiles and dependency caches remain native. |

Content-addressed ZIPs contain `PRESERVATION-MANIFEST.json` with every original
file path, byte length and SHA256, plus `objects/<sha256>` entries. To recover,
write each object's bytes to its recorded path as an independent file in a fresh
destination. Do not hardlink mutable recovery worlds. Original operation profile
maps retain input directory/mode metadata. TAR evidence retains its usual paths.
The source inventories and every archived file were checked again before native
retirement; archive creation alone was insufficient permission to delete originals.

Quality raw PNGs remain byte-exact in verified per-case/per-arm ZIPs. Host-side
`*-preservation.json` receipts identify the authoritative local/native location.
MakeUp G01's full successful capture and three earlier incomplete attempts remain
retained. Fresh BSL G02 is mirrored locally; most later complete sequences remain
under native `C:\ShaderLODBench\quality-archives`. Small temporary rehydrations for
pixel analysis were retired only while the verified off-host copy remained.
All2,178 successful images were decoded/hashed and all121 paired slots per case
compared; selected overview/unscaled crops and quantitative outputs are retained.
[Quality scope and numbers](quality-summary.json) define the acceptance limits.

Redundant local transport ZIPs were removed only after every extracted file still
matched its original independently verified transfer manifest. Their receipts and
extracted evidence remain; [retirement](transport-retirement.json) records the
initial batch. Logical byte totals and observed free-space changes are separate:
delayed release or concurrent activity can affect a measured free-space delta.
They are not summed as exclusive physical reclamation. The maintained32GiB reserve
was preserved; native free space was about33.19GiB after the completed campaign.

Authored phase helpers refuse replay/fresh-output collisions. V5 capture failures,
the V6 pre-launch headroom stop and the original waiting coordinator's failure
remain in logs. The single tail check used an explicit5GiB planning allowance
based on the measured full4K MakeUp compression/one-arm archival footprint; the
32GiB reserve was unchanged. It completed before the two final scored diagnostics.

# Native C01 core-profile state repair

The first GPU conditional functional check (makeup-c01-gpu-native-check-r1)
refused the depth-range/polygon-mode guard. It restored/released/reset completely
and is not a timing result. Source ownership and query creation had passed.

The old code required both elements of a two-slot polygon-mode array to be FILL.
The core specification has one polygon mode for both faces; compatibility has two.
A core driver may write just one element, leaving the second untouched. The new
profile-aware guard reads the actual context profile mask, keeps a two-slot safe
buffer, and checks one core enum or both compatibility enums. Unknown/ambiguous
profiles, non-FILL modes, nonstandard depth ranges and incomplete query output
still refuse. Sentinels prevent stale values from satisfying a failed read.
Last observed raster values are exported without extra status-time GL queries.

This is an API correctness repair, not permission to omit geometry or weaken the
existing source, bounds, current-frame depth and conservative query contracts.
The fresh native retry confirms the cause: profile mask1 (core), depth range
[0,1], polygon array[6914,0] (FILL plus untouched second slot). It exercises
27172 proxy queries and33965 deferred regions with no refusal and zero CPU
result reads in its functional candidate bracket. These are bracketed work
observations, not exact timed suppression counts or a performance result.

The [OpenGL4.6 core state table](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/specs/gl/glspec46.core.pdf#page=614)
defines the single polygon mode.22 relevant C01 Java tests and development
compilation pass on Asahi and Windows. The Windows test cache initially lacked
JUnit; a normal dependency download into the owned Gradle cache resolved it.

Before native source replacement, all5034 build bindings plus scripts/tests/
definitions were verified and preserved; the ZIP is also hash-verified on Asahi.
Only the two C01 source/test files changed on native, with before/after SHA checks.
Active follow-up is the V3 queue: the repaired C01 GPU check, separate untimed primitive
witness, remaining Complementary4.5/4.6 VRS checks and repeated original GL4.6
baselines. No C01 performance or quality conclusion yet.


Both the repaired GPU check and separate primitive diagnostic finish VALID with
configuration restored, whole-profile reset verified, exact runtime release and
zero clients. The32-frame witness sees1124032 expected native primitives and
zero suppressed native primitives in each GPU no-wait, GPU wait and CPU-decision
mode. Each mode issues128 proxy queries; GPU modes read zero CPU results, CPU mode
reads128. This bounded gallery scene provides no occlusion saving even when query
results are waited/read. It is an opportunity limitation, not evidence of a broken
GPU conditional path or general impossibility. Natural search and timings remain
separate pending cases.
